versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-video-content-extract.
- Supports video-to-text transcription, subtitle extraction, structured summarization, content analysis, and video-based creative writing via prompts.
- Handles public direct-link or complete video files (not live streams, encrypted, or certain platforms like Douyin/Xiaohongshu).
- Transcription automatically removes filler words and mistakes; output is customizable via --prompt for summary, rewriting, or translation.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable; only connects to https://www.guaikei.com.
